model.name: WebItem name+description harvesting + clipboard dialog preview
model.description: Before confirming a clipboard import, READ the clipboard and PREVIEW what it contains in the dialog (📧 Email: <subject> / 🔗 URL: <host+path> / 📄 Text (<n> chars): <first line>), THEN ask yes/no. Derive human-readable NAMES: URL → domain+path hint (e.g. "Spotify Episode"); text → trimmed first line; email → subject. NEVER a raw URL or timestamp filename.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (clipboard): show me WHAT I am importing before I confirm, and give it a real name — not a tracking URL or clipboard-timestamp.txt.

discoverySource.note: Clipboard confirm dialog showed no content preview + raw Spotify tracking URL as name.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The confirm dialog shows a typed summary of the clipboard content (email subject / URL host+path / text char-count + first line) BEFORE the user confirms.
Imported unit name is a human-readable summary (URL domain+path hint, text first line, email subject) — never a raw URL or clipboard-<timestamp> filename.
